verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for server-to-server calls without an end user. Each credential can only reach the routes of the scopes granted to it, the docs explicitly advise granting only what the integration uses, and affected credentials can be revoked from the credentials panel. Together this delivers scoped, least-privilege credentials suitable for an agent. missing for 10: a documented catalog of available scopes and their granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration (scopes also cannot be edited after issuance).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: A credential can only access the routes of the scopes granted to it, and scopes cannot be edited afterwards. Grant only what the integration uses.
The Conta Simples API uses OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for authentication. This flow is suited for server-to-server calls without an end user.
